LongDescriptionRus:
Историю Монтекки и Капулетти рассказывали тысячей способов, но редко так: **Barcelona Flamenco Ballet** переводит шекспировскую трагедию на язык фламенко, где вражда семей и страсть влюблённых выражаются не словами, а дробью каблуков и взмахом рук.

Труппа называет «Ромео и Джульетту» своим самым амбициозным и революционным проектом. Фламенко здесь встречается с современным танцем и джазовыми гармониями: гитары сопровождают тайное венчание, ритмы ломаются вместе с судьбами героев, а финальное примирение семей приходит через свет и тишину.

Спектакль идёт с живыми музыкантами. Вечная история о любви, которая сильнее ненависти, работает без языкового барьера: слова здесь просто не нужны.

Цена: от 2900 динаров.

Организатор: Mirshow.
LongDescriptionEng:
The story of the Montagues and Capulets has been told a thousand ways, but rarely like this: **Barcelona Flamenco Ballet** translates Shakespeare's tragedy into the language of flamenco, where family feuds and lovers' passion are expressed not in words but in drumming heels and sweeping arms.

The company calls "Romeo and Juliet" its most ambitious and revolutionary project. Flamenco meets contemporary dance and jazz harmonies: guitars accompany the secret wedding, rhythms break along with the heroes' fates, and the final reconciliation of the families arrives through light and silence.

The performance features live musicians. The eternal story of love stronger than hatred needs no language: words are simply unnecessary here.

## Who is behind the show

Barcelona Flamenco Ballet was founded in Barcelona in 2017 by dancer and choreographer **David Gutiérrez**, who still leads the company as artistic director. Its first production, “Tiempo Nuevo” (Flamenco Reborn), premiered at Barcelona’s Teatro Barts on 9 June 2017 and earned Gutiérrez a nomination for Spain’s Max theatre awards. It was followed by “Tormenta de Amor”, “Luxuria” and “Carmen” after Bizet’s opera, which the company has toured across Europe, the US and China, including earlier visits to Serbia. “Romeo and Juliet” is its newest large-scale production and continues the line of “Carmen”: a classic plot retold in the language of flamenco.

## Who dances and who plays

Seven dancers and five live musicians are on stage. The musical director is **Iban Pérez**. The score blends flamenco with jazz rhythms and harmonies, and part of the music is improvised during the performance, so no two nights are exactly alike. Tour announcements state that David Gutiérrez himself dances in the show.

The production breaks the “fourth wall”: at several moments the dancers interact directly with the audience. Costumes and sets are designed to reflect the characters’ inner and outer conflicts rather than to recreate Verona literally.

## FAQ

### How long is the show?

About 90 minutes of dance. It starts at 20:00, so expect to leave between 21:30 and 22:00.

### Is there an intermission?

On previous tour dates the show was performed with one 15-minute intermission. The Belgrade organiser has not published the running order.

### What age is it suitable for?

The company lists it as suitable for all audiences, while presenters in other countries have recommended it for ages 6+ to 12+. Keep in mind it is a tragedy that ends with the death of the main characters. No age limit has been announced for Belgrade.

### Do I need to understand Spanish?

No. There is no spoken text: the story is told through dance, music and movement.

### Which hall is it in?

The main hall (Sala 1) of MTS Dvorana, seating about 1,300.

### Where can I park?

The show is on a Sunday evening. Under the Parking Servis rules introduced in July 2025, paid parking in the central zones runs on Sundays only from 7:00 to 14:00, so street parking in the evening is free, but check the current rules at parking-servis.co.rs before you go. The nearest garages are Pionirski park (Dragoslava Jovanovića 2) and Zeleni venac (Kraljice Natalije 13). By public transport, take any line to the Terazije stop, about 130 metres from the venue.

## Ko stoji iza predstave

Barcelona Flamenco Ballet osnovao je 2017. godine u Barseloni igrač i koreograf **David Gutijeres**, koji trupu i danas vodi kao umetnički direktor. Prva predstava trupe, „Tiempo Nuevo“, premijerno je izvedena 9. juna 2017. u barselonskom Teatru Barts i donela je Gutijeresu nominaciju za špansku pozorišnu nagradu Max. Usledile su „Tormenta de Amor“, „Luxuria“ i „Karmen“ po Bizeovoj operi, s kojima je trupa nastupala širom Evrope, u SAD i u Kini, a gostovala je i u Srbiji. „Romeo i Julija“ je najnovija velika produkcija trupe i nastavlja liniju „Karmen“: klasičan zaplet ispričan jezikom flamenka.

## Ko igra i ko svira

Na sceni je sedam igrača i pet muzičara koji sviraju uživo. Muzički direktor je **Iban Perez**. Partitura spaja flamenko sa džez ritmovima i harmonijama, a deo muzike se improvizuje tokom izvođenja, pa nijedna večer nije potpuno ista. U najavama turneje navodi se da u predstavi igra i sam David Gutijeres.

Predstava ruši „četvrti zid“: u nekoliko trenutaka igrači stupaju u direktan kontakt sa publikom. Kostimi i scenografija zamišljeni su tako da odražavaju unutrašnje i spoljašnje sukobe junaka, a ne da verno rekonstruišu Veronu.

## Česta pitanja

### Koliko traje predstava?

Oko 90 minuta igre. Početak je u 20:00, pa računajte da ćete izaći između 21:30 i 22:00.

### Da li postoji pauza?

Na dosadašnjim gostovanjima predstava je izvođena sa jednom pauzom od 15 minuta. Beogradski organizator raspored posebno ne navodi.

### Za koji uzrast je predstava?

Trupa je označava kao prikladnu za sve uzraste, dok su organizatori u drugim zemljama davali preporuke od 6+ do 12+. Imajte u vidu da je reč o tragediji koja se završava smrću glavnih junaka. Za Beograd starosno ograničenje nije objavljeno.

### Da li treba znati španski?

Ne. U predstavi nema teksta: priču nose ples, muzika i pokret.

### U kojoj sali se igra?

U velikoj sali (Sala 1) MTS Dvorane, koja prima oko 1.300 gledalaca.

### Gde parkirati?

Predstava je u nedelju uveče. Po pravilima Parking servisa iz jula 2025. naplata u centralnim zonama nedeljom traje od 7 do 14 časova, pa je ulično parkiranje uveče besplatno, ali pre polaska proverite aktuelna pravila na sajtu parking-servis.co.rs. Najbliže garaže su Pionirski park (Dragoslava Jovanovića 2) i Zeleni venac (Kraljice Natalije 13). Gradskim prevozom do stanice Terazije, oko 130 metara od dvorane.
